integrity: Analytic Lévy-measure and cumulant proofs; exact rational reproducibility checks are supporting evidence only; independent validation not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Stationary scalar linear confinement, independent compound-Poisson impulses, logarithmic moment for stationary existence; polynomial identities need a finite fourth absolute jump moment. Finite-sample estimator variance and pathwise entropy production are not established. Priority remains subject to independent literature examination.
title: A universal two-time arrow for Poisson-kicked harmonic Brownian motion
